why: The bootstrap service deliberately panics (it tries to forget a request that is not yet expungeable). Per the Graypaper the panic discards every state change the invocation made — but the gas it burned still lands in the statistics.
family_explainer: The preimages family exercises JAM's data-availability contract for service code and data. The service SOLICITS hashes it wants (host call 23), the chain later receives matching blobs in the block body (the E_P extrinsic), lookups serve them back (host call 2), and FORGET (24) begins the two-step expunge dance governed by the D=32-slot turnaround period.
events: Core 1: package 5dba0167… guaranteed (3 work item(s), bundle 1917 bytes) — declares prerequisite 429cc8ed…. It now waits on this core for availability assurances.
6 validator assurance(s): core 0 has 6, core 1 has 5 vote(s). A report becomes AVAILABLE when votes exceed 2/3 of 6 validators (i.e. ≥ 5).

ACCUMULATION: package(s) 46546cd6…, 743202d7… became available and were accumulated — the service's accumulate entry point ran inside the PVM. The accumulated-set ring C(15) records them (sorted, ring 11), aging out after 12 blocks.
